title: nsevt: Calibrated non-stationary extreme-value tail inference
description: A dependency-light Python package for calibrated peaks-over-threshold generalized Pareto (GPD) tail inference: continuous and interval-censored (grouped) maximum-likelihood fits for discretised data, with profile-likelihood intervals for the shape and finite endpoint; grouped scale regression and profile-likelihood return levels; a complete-block permutation test of a tail-scale trend with an interpolated minimum-detectable effect and its Monte Carlo uncertainty; a sequential Monte Carlo precision protocol and finite-sample calibration suite that report simulation error and explicit stopping status; and a power-aware multi-source robustness analysis. The endpoint interval profiles the reparameterised endpoint rather than resampling, and a bounded tail is reported only when the whole 95% profile interval for the shape lies below zero.
